about.title: About attorney Hinkov
about.lead: Legal advice and court representation for individuals and businesses, with a focus on clarity, predictability and consistent action at every stage of a matter.
about.bio: Todor Hinkov is a member of the Plovdiv Bar Association and has practised law since 2013. His practice combines litigation and legal services for individuals and companies, drawing on his experience as in-house legal counsel to corporate organisations.
about.education: He graduated from the English Language School in Plovdiv and in 2012 obtained a Master of Laws degree from Paisii Hilendarski University of Plovdiv. His professional training covers contract, company, commercial, civil and administrative law.
about.experience: He has more than 13 years of experience as an attorney. He served as legal counsel to Bella Bulgaria from 2012 to 2020 and to SKF Group from 2020 to 2024. He advises on corporate and commercial matters, company formation and restructuring, contracts, real estate transactions, employment law and data protection. He represents individuals and companies before courts, notaries, enforcement agents and other institutions.

process.title: A clear process. Consistent steps.
process.lead: Every matter goes through the same clear stages – so you always know what comes next and why.

s1.title: Initial contact
s1.text: You send an enquiry or call. We clarify the key facts and the documents you already have.
